input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
Sure! My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information from me.
It looks like my messaging app currently cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next to get this working again?
I’d prefer not to change my mobile data plan. I’m okay with refueling some data—let’s go ahead and add 2GB to my line. What do I need to do next?
Yes, I’m ready! Please let me know what I need to do next.
I checked my phone’s status bar, and it shows that Airplane Mode is currently on, with the battery at 80%. What should I do next?
I’ve turned Airplane Mode off. Now, my status bar shows “No Signal” and “Data Disabled,” with the battery still at 80%. What should I do next?
I turned mobile data on, but my status bar still shows “No Signal” and “Data Disabled.” It looks like my phone isn’t connecting to the cellular network at all. What should I try next?
I ran the SIM card status check, and it says that no SIM card is detected in the phone. What should I do now?
I removed and reinserted the SIM card. Now, my status bar shows a poor signal, 2G network, and data enabled. The SIM card status check says it’s active and working. What should I do next?
I’ve changed the network mode preference to “4G/5G preferred.” Now my status bar shows an excellent signal, 5G network, and data enabled. What should I do next?
I checked my APN settings. The APN name is set to “internet,” but the MMSC URL for picture messages is not set. Is that something that needs to be fixed for MMS to work?
I’ve reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my phone. Now, the APN name is still “internet,” and the MMSC URL is set to “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” What should I do next?
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned on. Would you like me to turn it off, or is there something else I should check first?
I turned off Wi-Fi Calling, but I still can’t send MMS messages from my messaging app. Is there anything else I should try?
I checked the permissions for my messaging app. It has permission for SMS and phone, but not for storage. Could that be causing the MMS issue?
I’ve granted storage permission to my messaging app, but I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there anything else I should try?
